mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.status,ca.name category_name,b.name brand_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id) sku_count, (SELECT SUM(i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE s.product_id=p.id) sold_units FROM product p JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY sold_units DESC,p.id LIMIT 20

SELECT p.id product_id,p.name product_name,s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,iv.warehouse_id,iv.available_qty, (SELECT MAX(i.created_at) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.sku_id=s.id) last_sold_at FROM product p JOIN sku s ON s.product_id=p.id JOIN inventory iv ON iv.sku_id=s.id WHERE p.status='OFFLINE' AND iv.available_qty>0 ORDER BY iv.available_qty DESC,s.id,iv.warehouse_id LIMIT 100

SELECT p.id product_id,p.name product_name,x.units,x.revenue FROM product p JOIN (SELECT s.product_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE o.status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY s.product_id) x ON x.product_id=p.id WHERE p.brand_id=#{brandId} ORDER BY x.units DESC,p.id LIMIT 20

SELECT x.sku_id,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,s.price list_price,x.unit_price last_price,x.created_at last_sold_at FROM (SELECT i.sku_id,i.unit_price,i.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.sku_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC) rn FROM sales_order_item i) x JOIN sku s ON s.id=x.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE x.rn=1 AND p.brand_id=#{brandId} ORDER BY x.sku_id

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,x.sold_lines,y.returned_lines,ROUND(y.returned_lines/x.sold_lines,4) return_rate FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,COUNT(*) sold_lines FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON x.sku_id=s.id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,COUNT(*) returned_lines FROM return_item ri JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.id=ri.order_item_id GROUP BY i.sku_id) y ON y.sku_id=s.id WHERE p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY return_rate DESC,s.id LIMIT 30

SELECT x.sku_id,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,x.customer_id,x.order_no,x.first_bought_at FROM (SELECT o.customer_id,i.sku_id,o.ordered_at first_bought_at,o.order_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.sku_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at,i.id) rn FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id) x JOIN sku s ON s.id=x.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE x.rn=1 AND p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY x.first_bought_at,x.sku_id

SELECT pr.id,pr.code,pr.name,pr.discount_rate,pr.starts_at,pr.ends_at,pr.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.promotion_code=pr.code) line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.discount_amount),0) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.promotion_code=pr.code) discount_amount FROM promotion pr WHERE pr.status=#{status} ORDER BY pr.starts_at DESC,pr.id

WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS ( SELECT DATE(#{from}) UNION ALL SELECT d+INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d+INTERVAL 1 DAY<DATE(#{until})) SELECT d.d day, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity),0) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.promotion_code=#{code} AND DATE(i.created_at)=d.d) units FROM days d ORDER BY d.d

SELECT cp.id,cp.code,cp.minimum_amount,cp.discount_amount,cp.valid_until, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=cp.tenant_id AND o.total_amount>=cp.minimum_amount AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) eligible_orders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount),0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=cp.tenant_id AND o.total_amount>=cp.minimum_amount AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) eligible_amount FROM coupon cp WHERE cp.tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY cp.minimum_amount,cp.id
